faq.q: What is an AI automation recipe?
faq.a: A short, step-by-step plan that connects tools you already use, such as your phone system, booking app or Google Sheets, with an AI step to save time on a repetitive task.
Most use tools with free or low-cost tiers. Check each vendor's current pricing page; we don't list prices we haven't verified.

faq.q: Can someone build it for me?
faq.a: Yes. Every recipe has a 'Get this built for me' button that sends your request to StorenTech AI.

pages.label: HVAC
pages.title: Text back every missed call automatically for an HVAC business
pages.summary: When a call is missed during a job, send an automatic text asking for the address and issue, log the reply, and alert the on-call tech.
steps: Connect your business phone system (a VoIP service such as OpenPhone, Dialpad or a Twilio number) so it fires a webhook or Zapier trigger on missed calls.
In Zapier, Make or n8n, send an SMS: “Sorry we missed you — this is {Company}. Reply with your address and the issue (no heat / no cool / maintenance) and we'll call back within the hour.”
Log every reply to your CRM or a Google Sheet.
Forward the reply to the on-call technician's phone.

p: Tools: Phone system webhook → Zapier/Make/n8n → SMS → Sheet/CRM. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
SMS consent rules (TCPA and 10DLC registration in the US): only text numbers that called you, include your business name, and honor STOP.

pages.label: Salons
pages.title: Send a personalized rebooking nudge to salon clients
pages.summary: A set number of weeks after each appointment, send a friendly AI-written note with a direct booking link.
steps: Pick a rebooking interval per service (for example, 6 weeks for cuts).
Use your booking app's export or Zapier trigger (Square, Vagaro, Boulevard) to find clients who hit that interval.
Add an AI step that writes a short note using the stylist's name and last service.
Send by email or SMS with a direct booking link.

p: Tools: Booking app → n8n/Zapier → AI writer → email/SMS. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
Get opt-in for marketing messages and send at most one nudge per visit.

pages.label: Clinics
pages.title: Answer pre-visit questions with an approved-document FAQ assistant for a clinic
pages.summary: A website assistant answers only from an approved document (hours, parking, insurance, what to bring) and hands anything clinical to staff.
steps: Write one approved document with hours, parking, accepted insurance and what to bring.
Set up a website chat widget that retrieves answers only from that document.
Add a hand-off rule: anything clinical or personal goes to a human.
Review unanswered questions weekly and update the document.

p: Tools: Chat widget with retrieval from a fixed document. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
No patient health information goes into a tool without a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, and the assistant must never give medical advice.

pages.label: Realtors
pages.title: Draft listing descriptions from MLS fields with AI
pages.summary: Paste the MLS fields and photos into a prompt template to get a 150-word description, three headlines and a social caption.
steps: Copy the MLS fields for the property.
Paste them into the prompt below along with up to five photos.
Review every feature against the listing data.
Publish the description and use the caption on social.

p: Tools: ChatGPT, Grok or Claude. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.

blocks.pre: You are a real estate copywriter. Using only these facts: {fields}, write a 150-word listing description, 3 headline options, and one social caption. Do not invent features. Avoid language describing who the home is ideal for (Fair Housing).

p: Verify every feature, and avoid Fair Housing-sensitive language about who the home is ideal for.

pages.label: Any local business
pages.title: Draft replies to new Google reviews for approval
pages.summary: Each new review triggers an AI draft reply in your voice that you approve before it's posted.
steps: Trigger on new reviews (Google Business Profile email or API via Zapier).
Have AI draft a reply: thank them, mention specifics, and offer offline contact for complaints.
Send the draft to you in Slack or email for approval.
Post the approved reply.

p: Tools: Google Business Profile → Zapier → AI → Slack/email approval. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
Never auto-post replies to negative reviews, and in regulated industries never confirm someone is a client or patient.

pages.label: Law firms
pages.title: Summarize long legal intake forms for faster triage
pages.summary: Each intake submission becomes a five-line summary: matter type, urgency, deadlines, conflict-check names and missing info.
steps: Trigger on new web intake form submissions.
Have AI produce a five-line summary: matter type, urgency, deadlines mentioned, names for conflict checks, missing information.
Post it to your intake channel and CRM.
An attorney reviews it before any client contact.

p: Tools: Form → AI summary → Slack/CRM. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
Use a vendor with appropriate confidentiality terms. The summary is for triage only, not advice, and bar rules on client communication apply.

pages.label: Restaurants
pages.title: Get a weekly inventory variance alert for your restaurant
pages.summary: Compare weekly counts with last week and POS sales, then email the manager any item that moved more than your threshold.
steps: Enter weekly counts in a Google Sheet.
Run an automation that compares them with last week and with your POS sales export.
Flag items whose usage moved more than the threshold you set.
Email the manager the list plus a short AI explanation of causes to check.

p: Tools: Google Sheets + Apps Script or n8n + POS export. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
Thresholds need tuning for the first few weeks, and AI explanations are suggestions to check, not conclusions.

pages.label: Contractors
pages.title: Follow up on sent quotes automatically
pages.summary: When a quote is marked sent, schedule tailored follow-ups on day 2 and day 7 that stop as soon as the job is won or lost.
steps: Trigger when a quote is marked “sent” in Jobber, Housecall Pro or your Sheet.
Schedule follow-ups on day 2 and day 7.
Have AI tailor each follow-up to the job type.
Stop automatically when the status changes to won or lost.

p: Tools: Jobber/Housecall Pro or Sheet → Zapier/Make → email. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
Make sure the stop condition works before going live, so customers who said yes don't get chased.

pages.title: Chase clients for missing documents automatically
pages.summary: A weekly automation emails each client only the documents they're still missing, with an upload link, until everything is in.

Run a weekly automation that emails each client only their missing items.
Include a secure upload link.
Stop when every item is checked off.

p: Tools: Sheets + Gmail/Outlook via Zapier/Make/n8n + secure upload portal. Costs: see each vendor's current pricing page.
Never ask clients to send sensitive documents as plain email attachments. Use a secure portal.
